Work returns to dollspace-gay/Thermite by pull request rather than accumulating as a fork. Everything staged here stays cherry-pickable: one commit per RFC so each derives r1, branches cut from upstream refs rather than from the fork's main, and the process layer kept off any branch bound for a PR. A hard fork is an acceptable outcome and an unacceptable accident — if it happens it gets decided and recorded, not discovered six months later when the diff stops applying.
